name: Greed-extreme continuation in a confirmed uptrend (ride, do not fade)
rationale: MECHANISM: the technical-predictability literature finds crypto momentum works BETTER under optimism because investors herd and reinforce trends; naive symmetric contrarians who SHORT greed get run over during the herding phase. The persistent counterparty is the FOMO retail crowd that keeps bidding — you ride them, not fade them. Entry: fear_greed above a fitted greed ceiling AND adx above a fitted floor (established trend) AND ret_Nd positive (up-trend confirmed). Long continuation; exit when adx collapses (trend dies) or stop/TP/time. This monetizes the regime-asymmetry the family names and explains why symmetric fear/greed strategies barely beat buy-and-hold: half their trades (shorting greed in a bull) are wrong. DISCONFIRMER: directly compare fade-greed vs ride-greed on the same high-fear_greed days within confirmed uptrends; if fading is NOT strictly worse, the asymmetry is illusory. Kill if the continuation leg underperforms plain adx-trend without the sentiment gate.
catalyst: extreme greed inside a confirmed, momentum-positive uptrend
